scope: Derived artifact provenance manifests binding derived output payloads to sealed input hashes, allowlisted tool versions, deterministic config hashes, optional Ed25519 signatures, atomic staging persistence, and restart recovery

commands.output: Validated 40 detailed tasks, resources, references and progress; no runtime capability inferred.

Passed all 11 tests in cmd/breachatlas and all test suites in tests (C05 through C16, including 5 C16 provenance binding, negative tamper detection, Ed25519 verification, interrupted staging restart recovery, sealed source immutability, and concurrent race tests).
Plan validation, TypeScript check, Vite build, and web/contract tests passed.
VALIDATION PASSED: Checked 232 JSON files and repository contract invariants.

observations: DeriveFromIsolatedRun and DeriveFromAnalysis in internal/artifacts/manifest.go create DerivedManifest records deterministically binding input_hashes and per-input InputBinding metadata, allowlisted tool_version, deterministic 64-hex config_hash, and output payload SHA-256/size.

CanonicalManifestBytes and ComputeManifestDigest compute a canonical SHA-256 manifest digest; optional Ed25519 signing binds KeyID and ManifestDigest via CanonicalSignaturePayload and verifies against trusted public keys.

VerifyDerivedManifest and VerifyStoredArtifact fail closed on missing prerequisites (ErrMissingPrerequisite), malformed/missing config_hash (ErrConfigHashMismatch), missing or non-allowlisted tool bindings (ErrToolBindingInvalid), tampered input hashes (ErrInputBindingMismatch), tampered output payload bytes (ErrOutputTampered), manifest digest tampering (ErrManifestDigestMismatch), forged/untrusted Ed25519 signatures (ErrInvalidSignature/ErrUntrustedSigner), and path traversal/symlinks (ErrPathTraversal/ErrSymlinkRejected).

ArtifactStore persists derived outputs and manifests atomically using staging temp files, fsync, atomic rename, exclusive flock (.artifact.lock), idempotent operation_id replay with conflict rejection (ErrManifestConflict), and startup orphan cleanup on restart.
Pre- and post-derivation read-only verification against SealStore confirms sealed source bytes are never modified.

observed_limitations: Timestamp normalization with explicit unknown-zone and DST ambiguity tracking (C17) and downstream timeline aggregation are deferred to their planned tasks.
rollback_or_recovery_observation: Revert internal/artifacts/manifest.go, tests/provenance_test.go, tests/fixtures/breachatlas/C16, and docs/evidence/C16.json. No database schemas, migrations, .env files, or Dockerfiles were modified.
